why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with n8n
why_use_section.subtitle: n8n provides the extensible, node-based foundation required for secure and complex backend orchestration.
paragraphs: n8n is our primary choice for projects that demand data sovereignty and high levels of customization. Unlike traditional SaaS automation tools, n8n’s fair-code model allows us to host the engine on your own secure infrastructure, ensuring that sensitive data never leaves your perimeter while still benefiting from a powerful visual workflow designer.

The true power of n8n lies in its extensibility. Its node-based architecture allows our developers to write custom JavaScript logic directly within the workflow, or even build proprietary nodes to interface with internal legacy systems, providing a bridge between standard cloud services and your unique enterprise stack.
